name: Sampaguita Neon Heights
request: Cyberpunk map similar to the supplied neon skyline image

brief.composition: Dense upper skyline blocks, connected illuminated boulevards, hologram plaza and lower observation/maintenance terrace
brief.representation: Existing elevated 2D pixel stage, fresh neon palette and architecture from new reference

observations: Viewed assembled native map and eight-prop sheet on a dark background; reflective terrain and transparent cutouts retain the cyan/magenta reference palette and fine pixel detail.
Initial north skyline looked undersized; replaced five placements with exact integer 2x variants and inspected the revised overview. Upper stories intentionally continue beyond the north edge.
Refined solid footprints to visible bases; the overview shows an open central arrival, plaza and both boulevards. This is artwork observation, not verified actor clearance.
pending: Actor visibility and occlusion behind towers

liveReview.reason: No automated checks/tests/builds or browser verification requested

limits: Separate local stage; existing maps and user saves preserved
No new 3D renderer, combat, NPCs, rewards, accounts or overworld portals
Holograms and city props are scenery; no implied building interiors or vehicle controls
timingNote: Source service timestamps are measured per call. Authoring includes first export, native artwork review, skyline scale/footprint revision and second export. App/browser tests were not run.
